title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice P.M.Raval on 04.11.2026 in the Second session and Re-arrangement of taking up the matters of Hon'ble Court (Coram : Hon'ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen and Hon'ble Mr. Justice P.M.
text:

Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 04.11.2026;

FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-05/2026, dated 02/11/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 04/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
In modification of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 04.11.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice P.M.Raval would not be available in
the Second Session.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D.
Karia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice P.M.Raval)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
